The Question We Work On

As AI grows, how do you identify and nurture the human qualities that matter most, and how do you know they are growing?

The difficulty is one of pace. The technology moves quickly and crosses every boundary at once, and the systems that prepare people for work move deliberately and within their own. Holding both is the real work: moving at the speed the technology sets while staying grounded in academic values.

Our Approach

  1. We frame the problem.We ask what AI changes across human knowledge and work, and which qualities hold their value in every discipline.
  2. We approach the work.We learn alongside students, on ground that is new for faculty too. The work runs as small experiments of six to ten weeks, each a rigorous loop that identifies, nurtures, and tracks the qualities behind self-directed action.
  3. We understand our audience.Students who begin at community colleges and regional public universities. Fifteen years of knowing where they start and where they need to arrive.

Our Ask

React to the framework. Question the evidence. Partner with us on the next round of pilots.

What the Framework Aims to Achieve

1. SuperagencyAttempt problems you would not have tackled before, by combining human expertise with AI.
2. Human ValueKnow what only you contribute: judgment, context, creativity, relationships, and care.
Symbiotic Thinking Is the Foundation
The human-led practice of pursuing wisdom in partnership with other intelligences, human or artificial.

Where It Is Being Tested

Career Intelligence (Tests: SDL + IS)New graduates, six weeks. Pre and post evaluation plus a warm-referral funnel.
“Applying AI at Work” Certificate, De Anza College (Tests: SDL + IS + AB)Working professionals direct AI on problems from their own jobs.
Micro-Internships (Tests: the full loop)Real contributions inside real open projects, with AI and human mentors.
Reboot Salinas (Curiosity + Agency)Curiosity-driven AI exploration for high schoolers.
